column10: Thank you for agreeing to participate in this market research study. HEALOGIX is an independent healthcare market research agency. You may access our privacy policy at the following link: Privacy Policy – Healogix          As you may be aware, the requirement to protect the personal information of California residents in the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) came into effect on January 1, 2020. Should you wish to know more about what type of information we collect, store and use belonging to you, please contact Nadya Serrano from Healogix at nadya.serrano@healogix.com.          The information collected in this survey will be used for market research purposes only.  Your responses will remain confidential and will only be reported in total. Completion of this survey should take approximately 2 minutes.          This research complies with the ethical guidelines published in the Insights Association Code of Standards and Ethics.              Thank you again for your time, we sincerely appreciate your participation in this important research.           Please click “Continue” to proceed with the survey.

column12: Can you still find that conversation, or another health conversation with an AI chatbot, in your chat history right now?  (Please select one option)
